PROMPT, REFERENCE, LINEAGE, AND PORTABILITY

 [P] DiagramCodeEntityMapRecord
              |
              | DiagramElementMapping
              v
 [R] referenceFromMapping()          User-entered @entity/@diagram/@component
              |                                      |
              v                                      v
 [R] ReferenceIdentity[]                    [R] typed prompt options
 kind                                         typed tokens
 targetId                                           |
 origin                                             |
 sourceRange identity                               |
              |                                     |
              v                                     v
       [R] scoped reference buffer          [R] mention resolution
       project/set scoped                           |
              |                                     |
              +------------------+------------------+
                                 |
                                 v
                    [R] resolveReference()
                    checks target ID + origin
                                 ^
                                 |
                   [P] available workspace records
                   evidence entities
                   DiagramRecord{}
                   artifact components
                                 |
                                 v
                [R] createGenerationPromptConfig()
                                 |
              +------------------+-------------------+
              |                                      |
              v                                      v
 [P] GenerationPromptReference[]       [P] omittedReferences[]
 token + target + origin               known but excluded
 exact promptRepresentation
              |
              v
 [P] GenerationPromptConfigRecord
 system prompt
 context prompt
 optional reference prompt
 mandatory mapping prompt
 optional derivation
              |
              v
 [R] runGenerationPromptTurns()
              |
       +------+------+----------------+
       |             |                |
       v             v                v
 initial turn   reference turn   mapping turn
                optional          mandatory
       |             |                |
       +-------------+----------------+
                     |
                     v
           [P] DiagramRecord / Component
           recordOrigin
           generationPromptConfigId
           derivedFromDiagramIds[]
           derivedFromDiagramComponentIds[]
                     |
                     v
           [R] buildDerivativePrompt()
           walks artifacts and prompt configs
           reconstructs previous corrections
                     |
                     v
             Next derivative prompt


 PORTABILITY BRANCH

 [P] DiagramRecord / Component
              |
              +--> evidence dependencies
              |
              +--> DiagramCodeEntityMapRecord
              |
              v
 [R] DiagramApplication.mappedArtifactBundle()
              |
              v
 [P] MappedArtifactBundle
 artifact + evidence + spatial mapping
              |
      GET /api/artifact-bundle
              |
              v
       [X] Transfer boundary
              |
       POST /api/imports
              |
              v
 [R] DiagramApplication.importArtifact()
 validates provenance, dependencies,
 ASCII hash, range identities and bounds
              |
              v
 [P] ImportedArtifactLibraryRecord
              |
       +------+----------------+
       |                       |
       v                       v
 imported artifacts     imported evidence/maps
       |                       |
       +-----------+-----------+
                   |
                   v
       Available to future prompt composition
